context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: この世/イチゴ/味覚/いちご/訪ねる/アイロン/新生児/取り替え

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、この世、絶対、には、絶対、優しい人、絶対、たくさんいるのよ
lines.en: Sho, sweetheart — there really are so many kind people in this world, I promise you.
lines.style: Gentle, reassuring tone. Speaks slowly with conviction, as if imparting something important. Warm eye contact. A mother settling her worry into certainty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、イチゴ、絶対、ジャム、絶対、大好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I seriously, truly love strawberry jam so much.
lines.style: Bright, earnest delivery. Quick tempo on the opening. The specific gravity of a child declaring something he's absolutely sure about. No irony.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、新しいお店の、絶対、味覚、絶対、気に入ったらしいわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad actually loved the new restaurant's flavors, Sho — can you believe it?
lines.style: Warm surprise in the voice. A small laugh threaded through. Shares the discovery like she's in on a secret with him. Light, conversational.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、お庭で、絶対、いちご、絶対、育ててるよ、ママ
lines.en: Mom, Grandma actually grows strawberries in her garden — real ones.
lines.style: Animated, wonder-struck. The tempo lifts on the revelation. A child connecting dots with visible excitement. Pride that he knows something worth telling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今度、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんちを、絶対、訪ねる、絶対、わね、翔くん
lines.en: Then we really should visit Grandpa's house soon, shouldn't we, Sho?
lines.style: Thoughtful, warm. Speaks as if the idea is forming as she says it. Tender — inviting him into a plan. Slight upward lilt at the end, making it a shared decision.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、シャツの、絶対、アイロン、絶対、お父さん、絶対、かけてくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad actually ironed my shirt for me — can you believe that?
lines.style: Quiet amazement. The tone is small but solid, like he's noticing something adults usually miss. Speaks with the seriousness of a 6-year-old reporting important news.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃん、本気で、絶対、孫の、絶対、新生児、絶対、と、絶対、対面したそうよ、翔くん
lines.en: Grandmother actually got to meet the new baby already, apparently — isn't that wonderful, Sho?
lines.style: Soft delight. A mother sharing news with gentle wonder. Speaks with the warmth of someone who knows how much this moment matters. Trailing warmth on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、家具の、絶対、取り替え、絶対、ぼくも、絶対、お手伝いするよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to help you move the furniture too — I can really help.
lines.style: Eager, earnest offer. Slight breathiness on the opening word from wanting to be included. Speaks with the determination of a small boy proving his usefulness. Steady, not rushed.
